entries.what: Slept in until 9, then made coffee and went through the weekend's ticket queue from home before driving the 9 minutes down Ruel Road.
Swing shift in the IT cage next to the outbound break room; three frozen handhelds and a badge reader that wouldn't read were waiting.
entries.outcome: Cleared the pile before the night handoff.

entries.what: Ate a leftover rice bowl at her desk, then logged the scanners sent out for vendor repair in the RMA sheet.
Home at 11, watched a show with Iris and went to bed around 1.
Morning at home, then filled up at the Ruel Road station before shift.
Swing shift; Tuesday afternoon slot spent with Bao in the cage going over battery swaps on scanners.
entries.outcome: Bao swapped three batteries on his own.

entries.what: Carla messaged her cell about a dead scanner on the outbound line during night handoff; Noemi swapped it from the stock shelf.
entries.outcome: Picker back on rate in ten minutes.

entries.what: Late evening study session with the practice-test app and tabbed guide, mostly on port numbers.
entries.outcome: Got through one chapter before bed.

entries.what: Heat wave day; drove in with the AC maxed. Ridgeline added water breaks and the warehouse felt hot even from the cage.
entries.outcome: Arrived fine; shift ran with extra breaks.

entries.what: Heat made scanners overheat and lock up; she piled them in the cage and cooled them down one by one.
entries.outcome: Eleven handhelds in the cage by evening.

entries.what: Ate a rice bowl in the air-conditioned IT cage and skipped the outbound break room.
Got home to the Verdant Commons apartment and split a cold dinner with Iris.
Slept late and did a long practice-test block at home, with fans going on the heat.
Swing shift; spent the Thursday afternoon with Bao on trigger board swaps while Greg ate his turkey sandwich.
entries.outcome: Bao got a trigger board swapped without help.

entries.what: Iris ordered sushi for Thursday night and they ate it with the AC on full.
Morning errand to fix her mom's phone and printer at the fourplex off Vinca.
Swing shift; picked up Friday tacos from Taquería Colima on the way in during the heat.
Handled a badge reader outage at the north door in the heat and logged it in the internal queue.
Home after 11, gaming a little with the headset on before bed.
Slept in, then walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the heat early before it peaked.
entries.outcome: Short walk, cut off by heat.

entries.what: Afternoon study at home with the tabbed guide on subnetting, weakest topic.
Checked in on the household budget sheet with Iris over dinner.
Slow Sunday morning; lazy breakfast and cleaned the apartment.
Afternoon practice test, then went over missed questions.
Sunday night co-op survival game with her online squad.
